purpose: Add deterministic translation-only center-distance minimum/maximum limits around the preserved AXM Physics Core so UC can express rope/tether maximums, strut minimums and slack bounded ranges without pretending they are angular joints.

properties.limits: bounded array of center-to-center constraints with minLength and/or maxLength
properties.options: optional bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

relationships.basis: Exact distance joints continuously lock one center distance; distance limits leave configured range interiors slack and constrain only violated or outward-moving boundaries.
Distance limits can now share the composer's single donor-core integration step with translation mounts and exact distance joints while retaining slack-range semantics.
A distance-limit edge participates in connected-component collision isolation even while its physical range interior is slack; this topology effect is explicit rather than hidden.
The donor source remains byte-for-byte untouched; limit projection is an additive caller-side layer around one donor collision/integration step.

limitations: range interiors are intentionally slack and do not transmit tension/compression until a boundary is active
composer integration preserves slack semantics but inherits deterministic family-order bias and bounded-pass convergence limits
component collision isolation treats a configured distance-limit edge as connectivity even while the limit is slack
no local anchors, angular inertia or angular response
no hinge, slider, rotational weld, motor or gear constraints
post-core projection can move bodies after donor contact evidence was generated
persistent_state: limit definitions are explicit caller-owned JSON data

proves: maximum-only tether projection and outward velocity blocking
truthful handling of two immovable violating bodies
distance limits share one donor-core integration with the other composer families
active distance-limit residuals participate in convergence checks
slack interiors remain unconstrained inside the composer
distance-limit-only components are recognized by collision isolation
component topology does not silently convert slack limits into active physical constraints

truth.basis: The capability distinguishes slack range limits from exact distance joints and explicitly separates physical slack semantics from component-topology effects used by collision isolation.

agency.basis: Minimum/maximum lengths, correction strength, impulse caps and iteration counts remain explicit caller-controlled data; composition and collision isolation remain caller-selected wrappers.

continuity.basis: It grows through the existing composer and isolation lanes while preserving the donor core byte-for-byte and leaving standalone distance-limit behavior unchanged.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integration reuses the bounded three-family pass system and preserves slack semantics rather than flattening range limits into simpler exact joints for implementation convenience.
